creator: Alexander Terp
description:
From the second review of round 1's tab-holding fixes (2026-09-25), not fixed for 0.9.0:
- forward::hand_on discards the holding window's answer, so if B refuses a carried focus (the tab just moved or closed), A logs nothing - and A raises B before knowing B accepted.
- Sources/MusterMac/StateLocation.swift, the stale-claim sweep: it reads a claim and later removes it by path, so a launch that sweeps while another launch re-claims the same slot between the two steps deletes that fresh, live claim. Microseconds wide; matters only for simultaneous launches.
title: Two loose ends in carrying a request to another window
